files.src/apply.js: module.exports = (state, op) => ({ ...state, total: state.total + op.amount, seen: [...state.seen, op.id] });

patch:
--- a/src/apply.js
+++ b/src/apply.js
@@ -1,1 +1,3 @@
-module.exports = (state, op) => ({ ...state, total: state.total + op.amount, seen: [...state.seen, op.id] });
+module.exports = (state, op) => (state.seen.includes(op.id)
+  ? state
+  : { ...state, total: state.total + op.amount, seen: [...state.seen, op.id] });

checks.source: const apply = require("src/apply.js"); const once = apply({ total: 0, seen: [] }, { id: "a", amount: 5 }); assert.equal(apply(once, { id: "a", amount: 5 }).total, 5);
const apply = require("src/apply.js"); assert.equal(apply({ total: 1, seen: [] }, { id: "b", amount: 2 }).total, 3);
const apply = require("src/apply.js"); assert.deepEqual(apply({ total: 0, seen: [] }, { id: "c", amount: 1 }).seen, ["c"]);
const apply = require("src/apply.js"); const state = { total: 0, seen: ["d"] }; assert.equal(apply(state, { id: "d", amount: 9 }), state);
